title: 盖伦·蓝丝带礼物
description: 蓝披风盖伦穿完整银色甲胄，在桌前给小礼物系蝴蝶结，大剑稳靠支架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Garen is a broad adult Demacian knight with short brown hair, a square clean-shaven face, heavy silver armor, gold accents, and a flowing royal-blue scarf or cape. Preserve his exaggerated shoulder plates and recognizable sturdy silhouette with all limbs fully armored or clothed. His enormous straight broadsword rests safely in a floor stand, inactive and away from his hands.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small wooden table and concentrates on tying a neat blue bow around a tiny gift box, his large gauntlets making the task look gently comical. One spare ribbon spool and a cup complete the scene. The sword remains still behind the chair, with a pale stone window and soft paper background.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, silver gray, warm gold, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
